judgments.rationale: The proposed edit populates the action and action_quote fields with 'deem', which accurately reflects the operative statutory verb governed by 'shall' in F000 ('shall deem any person qualified to serve...') while preserving the remainder of the claim.

The proposed summary alters the statutory disjunctive 'or' preceding paragraph (5) in F004-F005 to a conjunctive condition ('unless all of the following are true... and (5)'). This distorts the qualification test by requiring every disqualifying condition to be met simultaneously rather than treating each item as an independent disqualification.
